headline: TikTok launches a standalone TikTok Shop app, not yet in the US
summary: TikTok released a standalone TikTok Shop app offering personalized recommendations, livestream and video shopping, exclusive deals, in-app checkout and customer support, but it is only available in a few countries and not yet in the US.
